name: corosolic acid
summary: Pentacyclic triterpene from Banaba leaf that activates glucose transporter GLUT4. Multiple small RCTs show postprandial blood glucose reduction of 10–20%. Most commercially available form of Banaba activity.
description: Corosolic acid is a triterpenoid linked to glucose disposal pathways and insulin-signal-related mechanisms, often supported by mechanistic/preclinical work.
safetyNotes: Mostly preclinical or extract-derived; concentrated doses may affect glucose, lipids, liver enzymes, or bleeding risk depending matrix.
dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
typical_dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (limited evidence) and evidence tier (strong evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
